description: Source code for managing user preferences in Mattermost, including retrieving, updating, and deleting preferences, with WebSocket notifications and plugin hooks.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for user preferences management.

methods.name: GetPreferencesForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all preferences for a specific user.

methods.name: GetPreferenceByCategoryForUser
methods.description: Retrieves preferences for a user filtered by category.

methods.name: GetPreferenceByCategoryAndNameForUser
methods.description: Retrieves a specific preference by category and name for a user.

methods.name: UpdatePreferences
methods.description: Updates multiple preferences for a user, with WebSocket notifications and plugin hooks.

methods.name: DeletePreferences
methods.description: Deletes multiple preferences for a user, with WebSocket notifications.
